title: What Grows in the Garden
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.Forest report after forest report names the Overgrown Garden in the west Old Wood. Steward Edric Vane wants the matter closed.

About

Given bySteward Edric Vane
Level49
LengthMedium
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

  • Living Moss ×3
  • Briar Heart Core ×1

Steps

  1. Talk to Steward Edric Vane (outdoors around 1710, 1769) to get the quest.
  2. Living moss (3) - Living Moss at 1733, 1796
  3. The Briar Heart at 1179, 1330
    Briar Heart core - Briar Heart Core at 1709, 1769

Rewards

Reward
Gold28,800
Character XP900,000
Quest points1

What Steward Edric Vane says

Ysolde Fairweather: It moves. Very slowly, but every strand leans the same way.

Ysolde Fairweather: Toward the Overgrown Garden, like a plant leaning toward a window. Something in that garden is drinking the light and spreading it.

Ysolde Fairweather: The Steward will want it dealt with. Please be careful.

Steward Edric Vane: The Briar Heart's core. I will file it under "resolved".

Steward Edric Vane: That is the first forest report this year to earn the word. Your fee, and my thanks, which I write down less often.

Handing it in

"That is the first forest report this year to earn the word. Your fee, and my thanks, which I write down less often."
